summary: Step-by-step for antsibull-changelog: install with pip, init the collection, optionally edit changelogs/config.yaml, lint fragments, and run release, adding --reload-plugins when rerunning for an unchanged version.
questions: How do I set up antsibull-changelog for my collection repo?
How do I check my changelog fragments for mistakes?
How do I generate the changelog for a new release?
Why didn't antsibull-changelog pick up my new plugin?

answer_card.title: Generate changelogs with antsibull-changelog
answer_card.answer_md:
Setup:
1. `pip install antsibull-changelog`
2. `antsibull-changelog init <path/to/collection>`
3. Optionally edit `changelogs/config.yaml`.

Release:
1. `antsibull-changelog lint` (optional)
2. `antsibull-changelog release [--version X.Y.Z]`

If you rerun `release` without changing the collection version, add `--reload-plugins`; plugin info is cached until the version changes.
